outcome: Bacterial pathogens isolated from blood cultures
Antibiotic susceptibility patterns of isolated pathogens
cohort: 142 neonates with clinical signs of sepsis admitted to a tertiary care center.
finding: The study identified various bacterial pathogens, including Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, from blood cultures of neonates with sepsis and determined their antibiotic susceptibility profiles.
mod_finding: 80 (56.3%) neonates were born by lower segment cesarean section (LSCS), 56 (39.4%) were born by normal vaginal delivery, and 6 were born by assisted vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Majority (90, 63.4%) had birth weight > 2.5kg, 37 (26.1%) had weight < 2.5kg, 13 (9.2%) < 1.5kg, and 2 < 1 kg.
